questions.title: Snippet Postorder Trace
questions.description: What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
def walk(n, out):
    if n is None:
        return
    walk(n['l'], out)
    walk(n['r'], out)
    out.append(n['v'])
t = {'v': 1,
     'l': {'v': 2, 'l': None, 'r': {'v': 5, 'l': None, 'r': None}},
     'r': {'v': 3, 'l': None, 'r': None}}
out = []
walk(t, out)
print(out)

questions.title: Snippet Depth Recorder Trace
questions.description: What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
def depth(n, d, acc):
    if n is None:
        return
    acc.append((n['v'], d))
    depth(n['l'], d + 1, acc)
    depth(n['r'], d + 1, acc)
t = {'v': 1,
     'l': {'v': 2, 'l': None, 'r': {'v': 4, 'l': None, 'r': None}},
     'r': {'v': 3, 'l': None, 'r': None}}
acc = []
depth(t, 0, acc)
print(acc[-1], max(d for _, d in acc))
